descr: Gemini 3.8 Flash leads MiMo-V2.6-Pro in Arena chat scores.
risposta: Gemini 3.8 Flash is the better model in the head-to-head comparison. It earned a higher chat score on the Arena and won about 52 % of blind votes. The margin is 17 points, which the Arena treats as a real lead. MiMo-V2.6-Pro trails in overall chat performance.
dimensioni: Gemini 3.8 Flash does not disclose its model size, so download details are unavailable. MiMo-V2.6-Pro is listed at 1024.2 B total size with 43.9 B active parameters and requires about a 622 GB download when using 4-bit quantisation.
velocita: Both models run only through an online service on common consumer GPUs. Gemini 3.8 Flash is marked as online-only for RTX 3090, RTX 4090, RTX 5090, RX 7900 XTX, Mac M4 Max 128 GB, and Ryzen AI Max+ 395 128 GB. MiMo-V2.6-Pro does not fit any of those home machines either, so neither can be run locally at full speed.
gratisA: Gemini 3.8 Flash can be accessed for free via Google’s Gemini API free tier. The service uses a proprietary license but does not require any local installation.
gratisB: MiMo-V2.6-Pro is released under an MIT license with open weights. Users can download the model and run it at home without any cost, provided they have sufficient hardware to host the 622 GB download.
sceglieA: Pick Gemini 3.8 Flash when you need the strongest chat performance and vision capabilities. It also benefits from Google’s reliable online API, which removes the need for local hardware. The model is ideal for users who prefer a managed service.
sceglieB: Choose MiMo-V2.6-Pro if coding tasks are a priority, as it outperforms Gemini in the coding category. Its open-weight MIT license lets developers modify and integrate the model freely. It suits hobbyists who want full control over the model on their own machines.

categorie.Chat: Gemini 3.8 Flash scores 1497 in the chat category, ahead of MiMo-V2.6-Pro’s 1480. This makes Gemini the preferred choice for conversational quality.
categorie.Coding: MiMo-V2.6-Pro leads coding with a score of 1624 compared to Gemini’s 1583. Developers looking for code generation should favor MiMo.
categorie.Vision: In vision tasks Gemini 3.8 Flash scores 1293, surpassing MiMo-V2.6-Pro’s 1247. For image-related queries, Gemini holds the advantage.
